rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a breed of animal or plant.

example.english: Dogs of this breed are very popular.
example.traditional: 呢個品種嘅狗好受歡迎。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ban2 zung2 ge3 gau2 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4

rows.note: Use 引起 as the all-purpose verb when one thing causes or results in another.

example.english: This will breed a lot of controversy.
example.traditional: 呢件事會引起好多爭議。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 wui5 jan5 hei2 hou2 do1 zang1 ji5

rows.note: Use this for a type or group of people who share notable characteristics, such as a “dying breed.”

example.english: People who still use film cameras are a breed of their own.
example.traditional: 仲用緊菲林相機嗰班人，真係一類人嚟㗎。
example.jyutping: zung6 jung6 gan2 fei1 lam4 soeng2 gei1 go2 baan1 jan4 zan1 hai6 jat1 leoi6 jan4 lai4 gaa3

rows.note: Use 繁殖 for animals or other organisms producing offspring, including the offspring-producing slice of sense 1, not for a place being a source of produce.

example.english: Rabbits breed very quickly in spring.
example.traditional: 兔仔喺春天繁殖得好快。
example.jyutping: tou3 zai2 hai2 ceon1 tin1 faan4 zik6 dak1 hou2 faai3

rows.note: Use 培育 when deliberately developing animals or plants to produce improved varieties or qualities.

example.english: We deliberately breed this kind of cat so the next generation will be healthier.
example.traditional: 我哋專登培育呢種貓，等下一代更加健康。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zyun1 dang2 pui4 juk6 ni1 zung2 maau1 dang2 haa6 jat1 doi6 gang3 gaa1 gin6 hong1

rows.note: Use 湊大 for the everyday bring-up-through-childhood sense, including the upbringing rather than specific instruction slice of sense 8.

example.english: Mum worked incredibly hard to breed and raise the three of us brothers.
example.traditional: 阿媽辛辛苦苦湊大我哋三兄弟。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 san1 san1 fu2 fu2 cau3 daai6 ngo5 dei6 saam1 hing1 dai6
